2) Lab: Username enumeration via response timing
 
See on response time
 
Use intruder pitchfork attack for IP and Username
 
Header - X-Forwarded-For
 
---
 
POST /login HTTP/2
Host: 0a97002203a6e2b9831c1414003c0046.web-security-academy.net
Content-Length: 2892
X-Forwarded-For: 1.1.1.18
Connection: keep-alive
 
username=azureuser&
 
---

Host: 0a97002203a6e2b9831c1414003c0046.web-security-academy.net
Content-Length: 32
